# DelightTech Pro

> DelightTech Pro is an end-to-end Shopify and eCommerce growth partner with 6+ years of hands-on experience. We build, fix, optimize and market Shopify stores for brands in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Sweden and the United Arab Emirates.

## Services
- Shopify store development and redesign
- Shopify store optimization (speed, UX, mobile, product pages)
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO) for low-converting stores
- Marketing and growth: Meta, Google and TikTok ads, SEO, email/Klaviyo flows

## Common problems we solve
- Shopify store getting traffic but no sales
- Low conversion rate or high cart abandonment
- Slow or outdated Shopify theme
- Launching a new Shopify store from scratch
- Scaling ads profitably
